State:
"Two snakes on a 12x12 board choose from the SAME frame and move simultaneously. Your head (8, 4), heading down, body [(8, 4), (8, 3), (7, 3)]. Hitting walls or either body loses. Same-cell heads or head swap loses for both. Tails vacate unless eating. Left/right are RELATIVE turns then one step. Opponent action is unknown. Distance is Manhattan distance. Options are not ranked."
